intent: The gods' roofless great hall: a narrow gold-inlaid aisle between two rows of colossal ivory colonnades under open transverse arches, ending at a stepped dais and an empty crowned throne under falling holy light.

critic.best_shot: feature-shots-final: nave down the gold runner to the throne
critic.why: A strong axial throne hall; one layout jittered, and the colonnades read as blank slabs.

role: Main-route platform: throne nave on a straight stretch.
notes:
# I

Keep: Keep the long gold runner ending at the crested throne.

1. Break the slab walls into real columns and arches; they read as monoliths.
2. Vary seeds: transept, two thrones, a bend in the aisle.
3. Light the throne end so the eye goes there.
